title: Less is More: Improving LLM Reasoning with Minimal Test-Time Intervention
authors_zh: Zhen Yang、Ying-Cong Chen（香港科技大学〈广州〉、香港科技大学）；Mingyang Zhang（蚂蚁集团）；Feng Chen（AIML）；Ganggui Ding（浙江大学）；Liang Hou、Xin Tao（快手科技）
paper_type_zh: 词元级高效测试时干预研究
best_for_zh: 具有解码 logits 访问权限，并希望在严格时延和显存预算下替代多轨迹搜索来提升可靠性的读者。
one_line: MTI applies classifier-free guidance only to high-entropy tokens, improving reasoning while avoiding the cost of guiding every decoding position.
MTI 只在高熵词元处施加无分类器引导，在避免逐位置引导成本的同时改善推理。
why: It makes the unit of test-time allocation a token-level uncertainty event rather than an entire chain, sample, or search branch.
inclusion_reason: It controls test-time computation at token granularity, showing that sparse uncertainty-targeted decoding can improve reasoning without scaling every token or generating many full alternatives.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Many test-time methods improve reasoning by producing more full trajectories, invoking auxiliary scorers, or applying a decoding intervention at every position. These strategies spend computation uniformly even though a long answer is not uniformly uncertain. A few unstable token choices can derail a chain, while modifying confident tokens can waste compute or disturb an otherwise sound solution.

The paper asks whether inference-time effort can be concentrated only on the small locations where the model is genuinely uncertain. It needs a signal available during one decoding pass and an intervention that does not require a separately maintained unconditional model state. The objective is to improve final reasoning reliability without turning every generated token into an expensive search or guidance operation.

许多测试时方法通过生成更多完整轨迹、调用辅助评分器，或在每个位置施加解码干预来改善推理。这些策略会均匀花费计算，尽管长答案并非均匀不确定。少数不稳定的词元选择就可能使推理链偏离，而修改高置信度词元既可能浪费算力，也可能扰动本来可靠的解。

论文研究能否只把推理时投入集中到模型真正不确定的少数位置。它需要一个可在单次解码过程中获得的信号，以及一种不必维护独立无条件模型状态的干预。目标是在不把每个生成词元都变成昂贵搜索或引导操作的前提下，提高最终推理可靠性。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
Minimal Test-Time Intervention treats token entropy as a local allocation signal. Normal decoding continues at low-entropy positions. When the predictive distribution becomes diffuse, the method applies classifier-free guidance to reshape the next-token distribution, targeting positions where a small local uncertainty is most likely to propagate into a global reasoning error.

To make this selective guidance inexpensive, the method does not retain a full second KV cache for an unconditional branch. It reuses the conditional cache and temporarily appends the negative cue “OUTPUT ERROR” to approximate a contrastive distribution. Thus the amount of additional computation is proportional to the fraction of high-entropy tokens, not to the length of the whole response.

最小测试时干预把词元熵视为局部分配信号。低熵位置继续正常解码；当预测分布变得分散时，方法施加无分类器引导以重塑下一个词元分布，瞄准那些小的局部不确定性最可能扩散成整体推理错误的位置。

为使这种选择性引导成本低廉，方法不为无条件分支保留完整的第二份 KV 缓存。它复用条件缓存，并暂时追加“OUTPUT ERROR”这一负面提示来近似对比性分布。因此，额外计算量与高熵词元所占比例成正比，而不与整个回答长度成正比。

title: Method
方法
html:
During generation, MTI computes Shannon entropy over each next-token distribution and activates guidance only above a threshold. At those positions it mixes conditional logits with a negative-prompt branch in log-probability space. Cache reuse avoids the dual-cache implementation of ordinary LLM classifier-free guidance; the negative branch is created by inserting a short error-oriented cue immediately before the uncertain token.

The paper evaluates direct inference, full-position vanilla guidance, and MTI across threshold values on MMLU-Pro, coding, STEM, and spatial visual-language benchmarks. Main results use greedy decoding, while AIME2024 uses eight stochastic runs. DeepSeek-R1-7B, Ling-mini-2.0, and Qwen3 models of several scales test whether a token-level intervention remains useful across different reasoning capabilities and output domains.

在生成过程中，MTI 计算每个下一个词元分布的香农熵，只在超过阈值时启动引导。在这些位置，它在对数概率空间混合条件 logits 与负面提示分支。缓存复用避免了普通语言模型无分类器引导的双缓存实现；负面分支通过在不确定词元之前插入简短、指向错误的提示创建。

论文在多个阈值下，于 MMLU-Pro、代码、STEM 和空间视觉语言基准上比较直接推理、全位置普通引导和 MTI。主要结果使用贪心解码，AIME2024 则使用八次随机运行。DeepSeek-R1-7B、Ling-mini-2.0 和多个规模的 Qwen3 模型用于检验词元级干预能否跨不同推理能力和输出领域发挥作用。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
At an entropy threshold of 0.5, DeepSeek-R1-7B reaches a 70.98% average across six reported general, coding, and STEM measurements, versus 61.70% for direct inference, while guidance activates on only 21.8% of tokens. Qwen3-14B reaches 85.33% versus 82.33% with 32.8% activation. On AIME2024 under sampling, MTI raises DeepSeek-R1-7B from 54.17% to 62.92% and Ling-mini-2.0 from 60.00% to 71.25%.

The paper also reports the efficiency trade-off directly. Across five benchmarks, Qwen3-14B at threshold 1.0 scores 80.70% with 4,551 seconds total latency, nearly equal to direct inference at 78.26% and 4,547 seconds, whereas vanilla guidance takes 12,411 seconds and scores 76.30%. In spatial VLM tests, activation is only 3.7%–4.5% of tokens while accuracy improves by 1.79 to 2.97 points, supporting the claim that useful intervention is sparse.

在熵阈值为 0.5 时，DeepSeek-R1-7B 在报告的六项通用、代码和 STEM 测量上平均达到 70.98%，而直接推理为 61.70%，引导只在 21.8% 的词元上启动。Qwen3-14B 达到 85.33%，直接推理为 82.33%，启动比例为 32.8%。在随机采样下的 AIME2024 上，MTI 将 DeepSeek-R1-7B 从 54.17% 提升至 62.92%，将 Ling-mini-2.0 从 60.00% 提升至 71.25%。

论文还直接报告效率权衡。在五个基准上，Qwen3-14B 以阈值 1.0 达到 80.70%、总时延 4,551 秒，几乎与直接推理的 78.26% 和 4,547 秒相同；而普通全位置引导耗时 12,411 秒、得分 76.30%。在空间视觉语言测试中，引导只覆盖 3.7% 到 4.5% 的词元，准确率却提高 1.79 到 2.97 个百分点，支持有用干预是稀疏的这一主张。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
This work changes the granularity of test-time allocation. Rather than deciding how many full samples, thoughts, or branches a prompt deserves, it decides whether a particular next-token distribution merits extra steering. The key empirical claim is that reasoning uncertainty is localized enough for this token-level policy to correct important decisions while leaving most of a trajectory untouched.

It also adapts classifier-free guidance to language-model serving in a way aimed at memory rather than only output control. Reusing the main KV cache and constructing a short negative branch turns an otherwise always-on two-branch procedure into a sparse, local operation. The novelty is therefore the joint design of uncertainty detection, selective intervention, and cache-aware approximation.

这项工作改变了测试时分配的粒度。它不再决定一个提示应获得多少完整样本、思维或分支，而是决定某个具体的下一个词元分布是否值得额外引导。关键实证主张是，推理不确定性足够局部化，使这种词元级策略能够修正重要决策，同时让大部分轨迹保持不动。

它还以面向显存而不仅是输出控制的方式，将无分类器引导适配到语言模型服务。复用主 KV 缓存并构造简短负面分支，使原本始终开启的双分支过程成为稀疏的局部操作。因此，新意来自不确定性检测、选择性干预和缓存感知近似的联合设计。

title: Limitations
局限
html: MTI requires access to token logits and KV-cache behavior, which may be unavailable for closed APIs or incompatible serving stacks. Its performance depends on entropy threshold, guidance weight, and prompt wording; low thresholds can disturb confident steps and high thresholds leave errors untouched. The paper tests many benchmarks but does not compare against every modern search-and-verifier pipeline, and the PDF does not expose a stable repository despite stating that code exists.
MTI 需要访问词元 logits 与 KV 缓存行为，这对封闭 API 或不兼容的服务栈可能不可用。其表现依赖熵阈值、引导权重和提示措辞；较低阈值会扰动高置信度步骤，较高阈值则会遗漏错误。论文测试了许多基准，但没有与每一种现代搜索和验证器流程比较；尽管声称代码存在，PDF 中也没有给出稳定仓库。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use this paper when a service has direct model-state access but cannot afford multiple long rollouts. It offers a different test-time lever from Best-of-N: profile entropy across an existing trajectory, intervene only where uncertainty crosses a validated threshold, and measure whether any accuracy gain survives the latency accounting. It is less suitable for black-box models or tasks where token entropy is not a reliable proxy for decision uncertainty.
当服务能够直接访问模型状态，却无法承担多条长轨迹时，可使用这篇论文。它提供了不同于最佳候选采样的测试时杠杆：在已有轨迹上分析熵，只在经过验证的阈值被越过时干预，并测量准确率增益能否在时延核算后仍然成立。它不太适合黑箱模型，或词元熵不能可靠代表决策不确定性的任务。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: Read the latency table with the entropy-usage column, not only the best accuracy row. The transferable hypothesis is that a decoding intervention should be evaluated by how often it activates and whether it changes the right token distribution, not only by the number of generated tokens. Before deployment, test threshold stability under the intended tokenizer, model calibration, and serving cache implementation.
应将时延表与熵使用比例一同阅读，而不只看最高准确率行。可迁移的假设是，解码干预应按其启动频率以及是否改变了正确的词元分布评估，而不只按生成词元数量评估。部署前应在目标分词器、模型校准和服务缓存实现下测试阈值稳定性。
